checks.finding: All eight in-scope requirements (REQ-001 through REQ-008) are mapped to acceptance criteria AC-001 through AC-012. Each criterion specifies an observable or measurable outcome (manifest schema/linter validation, byte-identical snapshots, deterministic boundary classification, SessionStart stdout/exit behavior, PostCompact line count, node-absent exit 0, security-scan findings, and documentation assertions), providing enough evidence for downstream verifiers to validate later.

Every stated goal REQ-001..REQ-008 has at least one matching acceptance criterion in the acceptance-tests table: REQ-001→AC-001, REQ-002→AC-002/AC-003, REQ-003→AC-004/AC-005/AC-006, REQ-004→AC-007/AC-008, REQ-005→AC-009, REQ-006→AC-010, REQ-007→AC-011, REQ-008→AC-012.

Acceptance criteria describe externally observable artifact, state, or behavior changes rather than vague intent: AC-001 checks manifest validation/version reference, AC-002 byte-identical outputs, AC-004/005/006 concrete boundary labels, AC-007/008 SessionStart output and exit code, AC-009 valid JSONL append, AC-010 exit-0 no-op with warning, and AC-011/AC-012 scan and documentation targets.

Non-goals explicitly exclude LLM summarization, SDD state-machine/validator/ship-workflow changes, blocking compaction, private conversation payload integration beyond documented hook inputs, and retroactive reconstruction. These boundaries prevent the feature from expanding into unspecified workflow or state-mutation territory.

Material constraints are stated: REQ-007 and Security Boundaries require no network, no secret reads, no LLM summarization, deterministic-only output, and writes limited to `.sdd/context/` and `reports/context/`; Assumptions specify Node 18+ with graceful absence handling, documented hook inputs, `.sdd/context/` git-ignored, and `reports/context/` committable.

High-risk claims have planned validation surfaces. Compaction-blocking risk is mitigated by REQ-006 and proven by AC-010; non-deterministic snapshots are mitigated by REQ-002 and proven by AC-002; over-permissive writes are mitigated by REQ-007 and scanned by AC-011.
The permitted filesystem probe confirms the repository root has no `domain/` directory, so the DOMAIN-CONFORMANCE check does not apply and is skipped per the role reference.
